notes.title: Patch Notes for Sep 12
notes.content:
[b]General [/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the replacement costs of all parts across the board 
[*] Increased sponsorship consistent income in the Top Fuel & Funny Car classes 
[*] Fixed input issues for various Thrustmaster and Logitech steering wheels
[/list]

[b]Audio [/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted engine sound effects during Staging phase for various classes 
[*] Fixed off throttle audio in-between gears for better transition between shifting 
[/list]
